Class MaxItemsCache<V>

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.ui.MaxItemsCache<V>
Type Parameters:
V - type of cached values
@NotThreadSafe public class MaxItemsCache<V> extends Object
Limited Cache A cache with max items limit, retaining most used items, and removing the least used items above given limit.

  • Method Details

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears the cache

    • put

      public void put(V value)
      Adds new value to the cache. If the cache items are above the limit, the least used item is removed. Added value is always considered as the most used.
      Parameters:
      value - value to be cached

    • iterator

      public Iterator<V> iterator()
      Creates an iterator of values stored in this cache. The values are returned in the "most recently used" order. A value inserted more than once will not increase cache size.
      Returns:
      cached values iterator

    • first

      public Optional<V> first()
      Get the first (the most recently used) value from the cache, if it exists.
      Returns:
      the most recently used value from the cache

      Returns:

    • getSize

      public int getSize()
      Gets the cache size (number of items stored in the cache). If a value was stored multiple times, it is considered as put once.

      cache size
